chem-atom-01-c2.text: Oxford Radiocarbon Accelerator Unit, University of Oxford. Radiocarbon Dating. University of Oxford, School of Archaeology.
chem-atom-01-c2.quote: After around 10 half-lives have passed, we reach the limit of the technique at around 50-55,000 years.
chem-atom-01-c2.claim: It's used for radiocarbon dating of once-living material up to about 50,000 years old.
